Do you know where the guild is?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
如果你有兴趣...就去看看吧！
你知道公会在哪儿吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey? Stop!
Aren't you interested in hearing a funny story?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿？停下！
你不想知道一个有趣的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Wow, you look busy.
Have you heard that there are visiters?
They're on a treasure hunt!
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哇，你看起来挺忙的。
听说有访客来啦？
他们正在寻宝呢！

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Eh?
I don't have anything for you...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
呃？
我没有什么给你的...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
You're not ready.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你还没准备好。

[Girl]
Have you been to the guild recently?
Some interesting things have happened lately.
Maybe new guests...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
你最近去过公会吗？
最近发生了一些有趣的事情。
也许是新来的客人...

scripts.text:
[Girl]

You should go and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我听说这和逐影有关。
你去公会看看吧。

[Girl]
Every time they visit us, they are on new missions.
What missions are they doing I wonder?
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
每次他们来访，都有新的任务。
不知道他们在执行什么任务呢？

You must visit there!

Lotte, you know what this means?

啊？这是什么？

[Lotte]

Then, why'd they use numbers to name the villages?

[洛特]
嗯，'3847147298' 这是我唯一用过的...

[Lotte]
Vin! This is crap!

[洛特]

[Vin]
What?
scripts.translation:
[文]
什么？

scripts.text:

Hey there?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Me?

scripts.text: Sorry, I am busy...

My name is Urupa.
If you are interested, could you come over here?

scripts.text:

[吓人的男子]

是的...

Damn...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

哇！
你就是那位！

[Lotte]

[洛特]
逐影猎人！
哇，我什么时候才能成为那样的人啊。

scripts.text:
[Lotte]
I don't need anything.
scripts.translation:
[洛特]
我什么都不需要。

scripts.text:
[Scary man]
Oh you are so talented?

scripts.translation:
[吓人的男子]
哦，你这么有天赋？

scripts.text:
[Urupa]
My name is Urupa.
If you have anything interesting just challenge it.
scripts.translation:
[乌鲁帕]
我叫乌鲁帕。

[Scary man]
What's your business?

scripts.translation:
[吓人的男子]
你找我有何贵干？

我不喜欢像你这样的人。我只跟非凡的人打交道。

Access to Premium content is only available to those who possess a certain amount of Reset Stones.
scripts.translation:
[不知从何处传来的声音]
只有持有一定数量的重置石，才能使用高级内容。

scripts.text: Yes

scripts.text: No

Good luck, adventurer.
scripts.translation:

祝你好运，冒险者。

我已经把密码给你了。
真是疯了...
你没有备忘录吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Nothing special...?
You've been to places...?
There's definetely something.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
没什么特别的...？
你去过那些地方...？
肯定有什么东西。

scripts.text:
Graham seems to know something.
I'd better go there again.
scripts.translation:
格雷厄姆似乎知道些什么。
我最好再去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
So, any improvements?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
那么，有什么进展吗？

scripts.text: Show him the key.
scripts.translation: 给他看钥匙

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Deception!
You are deceiving me!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
欺骗！
你在欺骗我！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
This is all?
Only one key.
How deceptive!
Just as I thought, it's a kind of treasure.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
就这些？
只有一把钥匙。
真是狡猾！
果然，这是一种宝物。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
You just gave me a shock.
Ok...
The code is kept in galleries.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
你真是吓了我一跳。
好吧...
密码保存在画廊里。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ok there's more galleries than this one...
Juno and Rachel have the codes...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
好吧，画廊不止这一家...
朱诺和拉赫那里有密码...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
This is just what I was guessing.
The codes kept by other galleries aren't treasures at all...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
果然和我猜的一样。
其他画廊保管的密码根本不是宝物...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Go to Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
去拉赫...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Find the gallery in Rachel...
Tell 'em that you just came from Graham and ask for the code.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
找到拉赫的画廊...
告诉他们你是格雷厄姆派来的，然后索要密码。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Ok?
Then go there!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
明白了吗？
那就去吧！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
There're four galleries...
Prontera, Rachel, Juno, and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
一共有四家画廊...
普隆德拉、拉赫、朱诺，还有里希塔乐镇。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
One of the codes kept by the galleries is already deciphered.
It's just one key....
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
画廊保存的密码里，有一个已经解开了。
答案只是一把钥匙...

scripts.text:
[Graham]
But here's what I am guessing.
The codes are linked to each other.
And the purpose is different for each one.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
但我猜测是这样的。
这些密码是相互关联的。
而且每一个的用途都不同。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
For example...
If one is just a key then the others are things requiring the key.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
举个例子...
如果一个是钥匙，那么其他的就需要这把钥匙。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
The key must be for opening the box.
Can you guess what's inside?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这把钥匙一定是用来打开箱子的。
你能猜到里面是什么吗？

scripts.text: Umm, treasure?
scripts.translation: 嗯，是宝物？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
YES.
That's why we're here!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
没错。
这就是我们在这里的原因！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
People think that we are just trading the stuff...
But we are here for very special things.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
人们以为我们只是在交易货物...
但我们是为了非常特别的东西而来的。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Go to ^4d4dffRachel Gallery^000000 and get the code...
They will support you if you explain everything.
Ok?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
去^4d4dff拉赫画廊^000000获取密码...
如果你把情况解释清楚，他们会支持你的。
好吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
How about everything?
We are dying to know about the key.
So you got support from the other galleries.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
事情都办妥了吗？
我们急着想知道钥匙的事。
你从其他画廊得到支持了吧。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Shadow Chaser!!
Ah!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
逐影猎人！！
啊！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
It's not intentionally decieving...
Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这不是故意欺骗...
哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Graham]
Isn't it interesting?
It's more than just taking exams.
We got to know about you and figured out who you are.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
这不是很有趣吗？
这不仅仅是考试。
我们了解了你，并弄清了你是谁。

scripts.text:
[Graham]
How's my acting?
It worked?
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
我的演技如何？
起作用了吗？

scripts.text:
[Graham]
If you need anything just ask them what you want.
scripts.translation:
[格雷厄姆]
如果你需要什么，直接问他们你要什么。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Only allowed for people involved...
Could you ask the clerk at the shop?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
仅限相关人员...
你能问问商店的职员吗？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Who are you?
This place isn't for you.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
你是谁？
这里不是你能来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
What are they doing up there?
Bleh...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
他们在上面干什么？
呸...

scripts.text: Give me your password!
scripts.translation: 告诉我你的密码！

scripts.text: I was sent by Graham.
scripts.translation: 我是格雷厄姆派来的

scripts.text:
[Manager]
You need my password?
How much would you pay me?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
想要我的密码？
你愿意出多少钱？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
10 million zeny?
Ok I'll take that then!
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
一千万Zeny？
好吧，我收下！

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Yeah right!
Who the hell are you?
How dare you just ask for my password?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
想得美！
你到底是什么人？
竟敢直接问我要密码？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Graham?
Why?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
格雷厄姆？
为什么？

scripts.text: You don't seem to have brought it here.
scripts.translation: 你好像没把东西带过来。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Are you mute?
I don't know why Graham sent you here.
Just go if you don't have any business here!
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
你是哑巴吗？
我不知道格雷厄姆为什么派你来。
如果没有正事，就赶紧走！

scripts.text:
[Manager]
So this key was sent by him.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
原来这把钥匙是他让你送来的。

scripts.text: No, I found it as the clue.
scripts.translation: 不，我是把它当作线索找到的

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Ah?
So doesn't that mean that one code could be exchanged as a treasure...?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
啊？
那岂不是意味着一个密码可以兑换成宝物...？

scripts.text: Maybe.
scripts.translation: 也许吧

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
嗯...

scripts.text:
- The manager seems -
- to be thinking about -
- something. Then he-
- hands over a paper. -
scripts.translation:
- 管理员想了一会儿，-
- 然后递给你一张纸。-

scripts.text:
[Manager]
No way.
Here's the clue.
Try to find it.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
没办法。
给你线索，自己找找看。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Anyway my name is Paul.
...........
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
总之，我叫保罗。
......

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Naturally...
I've already solved the clue.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
当然...
我早就解开这个谜题了。

scripts.text:
- Here's the paper that -
- Paul handed over. -
scripts.translation: - 这是保罗递过来的纸张。-

scripts.text:
R-E-N-N-N-D
L-N-N-W-W-N-D
scripts.translation:
R-E-N-N-N-D
L-N-N-W-W-N-D

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Isn't it so simple?
What do you think?
RENNND / LNNWWND means one thing.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
不是很简单吗？
你觉得呢？
RENNND / LNNWWND 代表一个意思。

scripts.text: I think I got it.
scripts.translation: 我想我懂了

scripts.text: I have no clue.
scripts.translation: 我完全没头绪

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Really? Then I don't need to give you the answer.
Could you interpret the meaning of each letter.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
真的吗？那我就不必给你答案了。
你能解读每个字母的含义吗。

scripts.text: It's kinda the combination of places.
scripts.translation: 大概是地点的组合

scripts.text:
[Paul]
So?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
那么？

scripts.text: E-N meaning East - North
scripts.translation: E-N 代表 东 - 北

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Ok that's good enough.
Then go and find out.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
好，这就够了。
那么，去查清楚吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Memorize this.
You might need it. It could be a clue for you.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
记住这个。
你可能用得上。这或许是个线索。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I don't know what it really means, but it would be helpful to you to figure it out.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我不知道它真正的含义，但弄清楚它对你会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
[ C O L D ]
C O L D?
I don't know what it really means, but it would be helpful to you to figure it out.
scripts.translation:

[ C O L D ]
C O L D？

I don't know what it really means, but it would be helpful to you to figure it out.
scripts.translation:

[ S E E D ]
S E E D？
我也不知道这是什么意思，不过你解出来会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
What? You don't know it?
Then you'd better think about it more.
It's so easy.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
什么？还没想出来？
那就再仔细想想。
明明很简单啊。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
So did you get what it means?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
那么，你明白它的意思了吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 是的！

scripts.text: No, I don't think so.
scripts.translation: 不，我不觉得我懂了

[ F O O T ]
F O O T？

[ S E E D ]
S E E D?
I don't know what it really means, but it would be helpful to you to figure it out.
scripts.translation:

[ S E E D ]
S E E D？
我也不知道这是什么意思，不过你解出来会有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Is it that hard?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
有那么难吗？

scripts.text: I can't do it...
scripts.translation: 我做不到...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
No way.
Can I give you a hint?
Compass!
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
真是的。
我可以给你个提示吗？
指南针！

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I've already given you all the info you need.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我已经把你需要的所有信息都给你了。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I've given you one more clue.
Isn't it enough?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我已经多给了你一个线索。
这还不够吗？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
As you and Graham mentioned.
Go and find it out.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
正如你和格雷厄姆所说。
去亲自找出来吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
If you find real things like treasure,
come back here.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
如果你找到了像宝物这样的真实物品，
就回到这里来。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
You must find the right place.
The word is RENNND
It's refering the cave East - North - North - North from this Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
你得找对地方。
提示是 RENNND，
代表从拉赫往东、再连续向北三次，找到那座洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
L-N-N-W-W-N-D is also same.
L is for Lighthalzen.
Lighthalzen - North- North - West - West.
That's the ice cave.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
L-N-N-W-W-N-D 也是同样的提示。
L代表里希塔乐镇：从那里向北两次，再向西两次，
就能找到冰洞。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Is there any improvement!?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
有进展吗！？

scripts.text: You need to investigate more?
scripts.translation: 需要进一步调查？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Really? Ok...
No way....
We will expect a good result.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
真的吗？好吧...
不会吧...
我们期待一个好的结果。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I am dying to wait for you.
So what did you find out?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我等得心急如焚。
你查到什么了？

scripts.text: I found the key.
scripts.translation: 我找到了钥匙

scripts.text: Hmm...
- You hand over the 'Illusion Key' that you found in the ice cave. -
scripts.translation: - 你交出了在冰洞找到的“虚幻之钥”。-

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Illusion! Haha!
After deception is illusion!
So are you lying to me?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
幻觉！哈哈！
欺骗之后就是幻觉！
所以你是在骗我吗？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I can feel how Graham felt it...
We don't dare to get that tiny key...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我能体会格雷厄姆当时的心情...
我们不敢去拿那把小小的钥匙...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
The young guy in Lighthalzen is quite challenging to deal with...
So we'd better request assistance from Haled...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
里希塔乐镇的那个年轻人挺难对付的...
所以我们最好向哈雷德求助...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Hey...
If you go to Juno...
There's a gallery...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
嘿...
如果你去朱诺...
那里有个画廊...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
So could you ask him to get the password?
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
那么你能让他把密码弄到手吗？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I feel like the red hair guy in the main gallery is teasing me...
Anyway...
So I really like to know the password and the identity of the key...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我觉得主画廊里那个红发家伙在戏弄我...
总之...
我真的很想知道密码和钥匙的身份...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
If Haled isn't supportive...
Tell him ^4d4dffI know what you did last summer!^000000
You shouldn't be wrong...!?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
要是哈雷德不肯帮忙...
就对他说：^4d4dff“我知道你去年夏天做了什么！”^000000
这样应该没错吧...？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
You could ask him to get the key...
He will help you if you tell him something...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
你可以让他去拿钥匙...
如果你告诉他一些事情，他会帮你的...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
If Haled isn't supportive...
Tell him ^4d4dffI know what you did last summer!^000000
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
如果哈雷德不配合...
就告诉他 ^4d4dff我知道你去年夏天做了什么！^000000

scripts.text:
[Paul]
So you are still looking for the treasure... right?
I would look for it...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
所以你还在寻找宝物...对吧？
我会去找的...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Now I almost guessed what would happen later...
It can't have happened!
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
我现在几乎猜到接下来会发生什么了...
这不可能发生！

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Are you shocked?
Don't think worse.
You could get a good person.
Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
你震惊了吗？
别想太多。
你会遇到一个好人的。
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Do you need a painting tool?
Then you can request that to the assistant.
We always have it just in case.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
你需要绘画工具吗？
那么你可以向助手申请。
我们总是备有一些以防万一。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
What?
If you've come here for some money, you are wrong.
This isn't a pawnshop.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
什么？
如果你来这里是为了弄点钱，那你找错地方了。
这里不是当铺。

scripts.text: You are... Haled?
scripts.translation: 你是...哈雷德？

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Hmm? I'm the manager of this workplace in Juno. What's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
嗯？我是朱诺这家店的管理员。怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Hmm. You were sent by Graham and Paul?
I thought that you just came here to beg for money with fossil pieces.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
嗯。你是格雷厄姆和保罗派来的？
我还以为你只是拿着化石碎片来乞讨钱财呢。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
It's a classic way that poor scholars use.
Sometimes I buy good stuff so some people know that this is a pawnshop.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
穷学者常用这招。
我偶尔也会收些好东西，让大家知道这里是当铺。

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Let me hear your story.
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
让我听听你的故事。

scripts.text: - You explain everything so far and show the key of arrogance. -
scripts.translation: - 你解释了目前发生的一切，并展示了傲慢之钥。-

scripts.text:
[Haled]
So...
I totally understand.
It's this key's location that
shared the informaton!
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
原来如此...
我全明白了。
是这把钥匙的位置
泄露了情报！

scripts.text:
[Haled]
Anyway. Two are keys and the treasure that I have to open with this key, what can I do?
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
也就是说，两把是钥匙，还有一件要用它们开启的宝物...我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Haled]
We will investigate Juno's workplace, so give it to me?
scripts.translation:
[哈雷德]
我们要调查朱诺的工作场所，所以把它交给我？

scripts.text:
- Haled doesn't want to cooperate with you.
Remember what Paul said. -
scripts.translation:
- 哈雷德不想与你合作。
记住保罗说的话。-

[维森特]
哈哈...
请别介意，邓克不太会说话。
他连等级不够的人都懒得理。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
And as person who isn't not ready.
^4d4dffYou maybe are not ready for him^000000.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
而且对于还没准备好的人来说，
^4d4dff你可能还没准备好面对他^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You talk too much.
Heh.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你话太多了。
哼。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
- He is pleased. -
Hey.
He could be ashamed.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
- 他挺高兴的。-
嘿，他可能会不好意思呢。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's you? You are the one who found the brush?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
是你吗？你就是找到那把刷子的人？

scripts.text: Show the brush to him.
scripts.translation: 把刷子给他看

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
That's it.
Did you find it by yourself?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
就是这把。
是你自己找到的吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: With my friends
scripts.translation: 和朋友一起

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hmm...
You have a high ability.
Breaking the codes should have been tough.
But it wasn't for you.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
嗯...
你很有本事嘛。
这些密码本来很难破解，
不过对你来说不算什么。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Hmm...
That's your other skill.
People who have no friends must be lonely.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
嗯...
这也算你的本事吧。
没有朋友的人一定很孤单。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
To us, relationships are very important.
You get more people, you get more help.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
人脉对我们很重要。
认识的人越多，能得到的帮助也越多。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's time to introduce myself.
I'm Dumk.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
该自我介绍了。
我叫邓克。

scripts.text: You are...
scripts.translation: 你是...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Chicken! How about the chicken for this supper?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
鸡！今晚吃鸡怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Why chicken?
Why are you interrupting?
You wanna be fired?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
怎么又是鸡？
别打岔！
想被炒鱿鱼吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Sorry...
 
(He turns to you and says it's taboo to talk about chicken.)
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
抱歉...

（他转向你，小声说谈鸡是禁忌。）

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Anyway, let's make a point.
You.
Will you yield to the will of the brush?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
说正事。
你，
愿意听从这支画笔的意志吗？

scripts.text: Yield to? What?
scripts.translation: 顺从？什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
This brush was used by the master.
Paintings by him have mysterious power.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
这是大师用过的画笔。
他的画作蕴藏着神秘力量。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
I can't tell you the root of the power.
Someday you will find out.
He sublimates power through the medium of his paintings.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我不能告诉你力量的根源。
总有一天你会明白。
大师能借画作这一媒介升华力量。

scripts.text: I don't get it...?
scripts.translation: 我不明白...

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We walk in darkness without moonlight.
And find out our shining days are over.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我们在无月的黑暗中前行，
才发现辉煌的日子已经过去。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We follow to other shadows
and we can be real
Shadow Chasers!
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
追随别人的影子，
我们才能成为真正的
逐影！

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
He suggests that you become a Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
他建议你成为一名逐影猎人。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
In our guild, there is a special group that have unique skills.
They are Shadow Chasers.
They usually hide ther figure and they think they are different from others.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
公会里有一群身怀独特技能的人，
他们就是逐影。
他们常隐匿身形，自认与众不同。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Don't be so sarcastic, Vicente!
I told you.
You are qualified to be a Shadow Chaser!
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
维森特，别挖苦人！
我说过了，
你有资格成为逐影！

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Give that brush to me.
I need it again.
I'm so thirsty.
Wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
把画笔给我。
我还要再用一次。
渴死我了。
等一下。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Let me see...
Did you bring the brush?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我看看...
画笔带来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
What are you doing?
Show me the brush?
You didn't bring it?
You are not very careful...
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你在做什么？
把画笔给我看看。
没带来吗？
真粗心...

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So, do you want me to keep talking about Shadow Chasers?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
还想听我继续介绍逐影吗？

scripts.text: What is a Shadow Chaser?
scripts.translation: 什么是逐影猎人？

scripts.text: Change me to Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation: 让我成为逐影猎人

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Most spells are exclusively for Wizards and their kind.
But Knight has since been able to use a kind of magic with things called Runes.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
大多数法术都是巫师一类职业专用的。
不过，骑士也能借助符文施展魔法。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So we tried finding a medium for spells that suit our characteristics.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
于是我们开始寻找适合自己、能用来施展法术的媒介。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So finally...
We found paint!
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
最后...
我们找到了颜料！

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Paint gives us lots of feelings.
We can feel peaceful and happy or it can give us feelings of sorrow and fear.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
颜料能唤起各种情绪，
让人平静、快乐，也能带来悲伤与恐惧。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We use that to harness the different emotions of people and exploit them when they're most vulnerable.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我们借此操纵人们的情绪，
趁他们最脆弱时加以利用。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
The effects on our enemies are similar to that of magic spells.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
这种力量对敌人的效果，就像魔法一样。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
For instance, this power could be used to create blackholes to make your enemies vanish.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
例如，这种力量可以用来创造黑洞，让你的敌人消失。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So if you want to have that power then you must have artistry.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
想掌握这种力量，就得有艺术天赋。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You have to be a trendsetter when it comes to fashion!
The ability to understand art!
You should have everything.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
时尚方面要走在潮流前端！
还得懂得欣赏艺术！
这些本领你都得有。

scripts.text: Then what is the Master Brush?
scripts.translation: 那么，大师之笔是什么？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Ah?
That was a brush who was a master of dark arts.
Now we are looking for someone who can be a Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
啊？
那是大师用过的一支画笔，蕴含着暗术。
我们现在正寻找能成为逐影的人。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
This is a kind of game.
If there is someone who wants to become a Shadow Chaser,
we just start the process to find this brush.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
这就像一场游戏。
只要有人想成为逐影，
我们就启动寻找这支画笔的流程。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We put the codes to make sure that you can think outside of the box.
Did you have fun?
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我们设下这些密码，是想看看你能不能跳出框架思考。
过程有趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You decided!
As your case, you can master the art of psychological warfare using paint!
The art created is beautiful but dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你决定了！
就你的情况而言，你可以掌握用颜料进行心理战的艺术！
创造出的艺术是美丽但危险的。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
We use paint as a medium for spells.
We use that to harness the different emotions of people and exploit them when they're most vulnerable.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
我们将颜料作为施展法术的媒介。
借此操控人们不同的情绪，并在他们最脆弱时加以利用。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
For instance, this power could be used to create black holes to make your enemies vanish.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
例如，这股力量可以用来制造黑洞，让敌人消失。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
So if you want to have that power then you must have artistry.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
想掌握这种力量，就得有艺术天赋。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You have to be a trendsetter when it comes to fashion!
The ability to understand art!
You should have everything.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
时尚方面要走在潮流前端！
还得懂得欣赏艺术！
这些本领你都得有。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You performed your duties diligently and found the brush.
So you are qualified to be a Shadow Chaser.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你认真完成了任务，也找到了画笔。
所以你有资格成为逐影。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Congratulations.
Welcome to your new life.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
恭喜。
欢迎开启你的新生活。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
It's a fashionable uniform.
It uses patterns of leopard and feathers
The fashion world will be shocked.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
这套制服可时髦了。
豹纹搭配羽毛图案，
时尚界肯定会大吃一惊。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
This shadow peacock I designed myself.
It's too hard to create something that absorbs my art sense.
Then about this part...
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
这只影孔雀是我亲手设计的。
要做出能体现我艺术品味的作品可不容易。
至于这一部分...

scripts.text:
Dumk keeps talking about fashion, art sense, paint and feeling.
He's obviously in his own world.
scripts.translation:
邓克一直在谈论时尚、艺术感、颜料和感觉。
他显然沉浸在自己的世界里。

scripts.text: About this brush...
scripts.translation: 关于这把刷子...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, I'll expain.
We need tools for painting.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
啊，我来解释一下。
绘画得用专门的工具。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
The make-up brush is used for face painting.
You can get paint from the workplace.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
化妆刷是用来在脸上作画的。
颜料可以在工作场所领取。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
The paint brush is used for painting big spaces.
You can get paint from the workplace too.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
毛刷用于大面积绘画。
同样可以在工作场所领取颜料。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Don't you remember the location of the workplace?
Juno, Prontera, Rachel and Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你不记得工作地点的位置了吗？
朱诺、普隆德拉、拉赫和里希塔乐镇。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
If you need paint, go to an assistant.
^4d4dffIf you don't have any tools, you can use skill needed paints.^000000
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
要颜料就去找助手。
^4d4dff没有工具也没关系，你可以直接使用技能所需的颜料。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Congratulations to be our person.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
恭喜你加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
What?
Why not?
You don't want to be a Shadow Chaser?
I can teach you so much about painting.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
什么？为什么？
你不想成为逐影吗？
我可以教你很多绘画知识啊。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
You really won't understand until you become one.
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
等你成为逐影，自然就会明白。

scripts.text:
[Dumk]
Don't you want to learn how to harness a power stronger than what you know?
....
scripts.translation:
[邓克]
你不想学会驾驭超越现有认知的力量吗？
...

scripts.text: Dumk seemed to be dissapointed because I didn't answer him.
scripts.translation: 邓克似乎因为我没回答他而感到失望。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I'm sorry.
He is not interested in other people.
But you can't enter this space.
You can get tools at the store.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
抱歉。
他不太在意别人。
不过这片区域不能进入，
工具可以去商店买。

scripts.text:
A blue flame is roaring.
The deciphered code means...
scripts.translation:
蓝色的火焰正在咆哮。
解读出的密码意味着...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What was it?
I guess I have to make sure I don't use any capital letters.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是什么？
看来我必须确保不使用任何大写字母。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4d4dff{1}^000000
It's clearly pointing to this.
You just murmur the sentence when the flame begins growing.
scripts.translation: 你低声念出那句话，火焰随即升腾。

scripts.text:
[Unknown voice]
Hm? Someone is coming?
You are the one who wants to have my treasure?
But your limitation is over.
scripts.translation:
[未知的声音]
嗯？有人来了？
你就是想要我的宝物的人吗？
不过，你的考验已经结束了。

scripts.text:
The flame is talking.
The voice is snake-like.
In the middle of blue flame, there are two marble eyes.
scripts.translation:
火焰竟然开口说话，声音嘶嘶作响，像蛇一样。
蓝色火焰中央，嵌着两颗玻璃珠般的眼睛。

scripts.text: Pick it up.
scripts.translation: 捡起它

scripts.text:
[Unknown voice]
You are in a hurry.
Hahaha, humans usually do things like that.
They can't see the truth.
scripts.translation:
[未知的声音]
真心急啊。
哈哈，人类总是这样。
他们看不见真相。

scripts.text:
[Unknown voice]
How about you?
I don't expect that you will do harm to this blue flame.
It's the only one with two...
scripts.translation:
[未知的声音]
你呢？
我想你不会伤害这团蓝色火焰。
它是唯一有两只...

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Shadow of Deception]
Me? I'm a deception.
I sneer at people who are stupid.
I laugh behind their backs.
HahaHaha...
scripts.translation:
[欺瞒之影]
我？我是一个欺骗者。
我嘲笑那些愚蠢的人。
我在他们背后嘲笑。
哈哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
The Blue Flame is growning and rolling.
They seem to be related.
scripts.translation:
蓝色火焰翻涌升腾。
它们之间似乎有所关联。

scripts.text:
It looks like the blue flame is under the limitation.
You can't feel that rolling effect of a spell like before.
scripts.translation:
看起来蓝色火焰受到了限制。
你感觉不到之前那种法术翻滚的效果了。

scripts.text: Pick up the marbles.
scripts.translation: 捡起玻璃珠

scripts.text: When you pick them up, you can feel that your weight is lightened.
scripts.translation: 捡起玻璃珠后，你觉得身上的负重减轻了。

scripts.text:
The flame is still rolling with a strong spell.
You have to cut the relation with it.
scripts.translation:
火焰仍在强烈法术的作用下翻涌。
你必须切断与它的联系。

scripts.text:
It looks like the blue flame is under the limitation.
You can't feel that rolling effect of a spell like before.
scripts.translation:
看起来蓝色火焰受到了限制。
你感觉不到之前那种法术翻滚的效果了。

scripts.text: Pick up the marbles.
scripts.translation: 捡起玻璃珠

scripts.text: When you pick it up, you can feel that your weight is lightened.
scripts.translation: 捡起玻璃珠后，你觉得身上的负重减轻了。

scripts.text: The flame is rolling.
scripts.translation: 火焰正在翻滚。

scripts.text: An unknown red flame is roaring.
scripts.translation: 一团陌生的红色火焰熊熊燃烧。

scripts.text:
The red flame is roaring.
It changed to a woman in black.
scripts.translation:
红色火焰熊熊燃烧，
随后化作一名黑衣女子。

scripts.text:
[Woman in black]
Can you hear me?
Huhu.
Can you see me?
scripts.translation:
[黑衣女子]
听见了吗？
呵呵。
看见我了吗？

scripts.text:
[Woman in black]
You are the chosen one?
You can know that.
There is a soul that is the same as me.
scripts.translation:
[黑衣女子]
你就是被选中的人？
你应该能感觉到，
有一个灵魂与我相同。

scripts.text:
[Woman in black]
I'm a shadow.
A wandering shadow.
Sad soul.
A shadow of illusion without truth.
scripts.translation:
[黑衣女子]
我是一抹影子。
游荡的影子。
悲伤的灵魂。
虚幻无真的影子。

scripts.text:
[Shadow of Illusion]
What do you want?
Do you want treasure?
Then pick it up.
Tear my soul and
show the truth.
scripts.translation:
[幻影之影]
你想要什么？
想要宝物吗？那就拿去吧。
撕开我的灵魂，
让真相显现。

scripts.text:
You can't feel the soul from the flame.
When you go closer, you can't see well because of darkness.
scripts.translation:
你感受不到火焰中的灵魂。
再靠近些，黑暗让你看不清。

scripts.text:
[Shadow of Illusion]
Huhu.
What's wrong?
You couldn't find the half of my soul?
Huhu...
scripts.translation:
[幻影之影]
呵呵。
怎么了？
找不到我灵魂的另一半吗？
呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Shadow of Illusion]
Ah, hurry and give me rest.
I want to die softly.
I want to give up the phony life.
scripts.translation:
[幻影之影]
啊，快让我安息吧。
我想平静地死去，
摆脱这虚假的生活。

scripts.text:
[Shadow of Illusion]
Huhu...
When the false shadow is gone, you can see the truth.
Please, tear the false to dazzle who are blind...
Without any trace...
scripts.translation:
[幻影之影]
呵呵...
虚假的影子消失后，你就能看见真相。
撕开虚伪，让盲目者看见光明...
不留痕迹...

scripts.text:
The flame is rolling.
You can't see well because of the light of ice.
scripts.translation:
火焰翻涌不止。
冰冷的光芒刺得你看不清。

scripts.text:
That's a mysterious flame.
It looks like cursing.
Go away form that.
scripts.translation:
那团火焰透着诡异，
似乎带有诅咒。
离它远一些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The poem that Haled told me was pointing to Niflheim.
There is a flame that looks like the one from turtle island and ice dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈雷德告诉我的那首诗指向了尼弗海姆。
那里有一团火焰，看起来像海龟岛和冰洞里的火焰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The end of living tree's roots.
Tears of all living people.
Sign of all dead people.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
生命之树的根之尽头。
所有生者的泪水。
所有死者的标志。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They are us but also not us.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它们是我们，但也不是我们。

scripts.text:
[Someone's voice]
They are us but also not us.
scripts.translation:
[某人的声音]
它们是我们，但也不是我们。

scripts.text:
[Someone's voice]
Residents of the night forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[某人的声音]
被遗忘的夜之居民...

scripts.text: Who is playing that?
scripts.translation: 谁在演奏？

scripts.text:
[Someone's voice]
Who is playing the waltz of desperation?
.....
scripts.translation:
[某人的声音]
是谁在演奏绝望的华尔兹？
......

scripts.text:
[Someone's voice]
